newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moulinex sets 525 mln Ffr capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Moulinex sets 525 mln Ffr capital increase.

text.p: French appliance manufacturer Moulinex set a 525 million franc capital increase on Friday.
It said it would issue 5,646,191 shares priced at 93 francs each.
It said the one-for-five share issue would run from January 28 to February 10.
"Certain shareholders have already pledged to subscribe to the maximum possible for a total amount representing 40 percent of the issue," Moulinex said in a statement.
Moulinex said last month it would seek a 500 million franc capital increase and said its principal shareholders, including Societe Financiere Moulinex, had agreed to subscribe.
The appliance maker is embarking on a restructuring plan entailing layoffs and plant closures to try to match the productivity levels of its rivals.
